Hi all —

Thanks for the data, Sofie — attached are two scenarios and a short unit-econ summary (PDF + spreadsheet):
- Scenario A (Conservative): assumes no reserved commitment, hosted list pricing, limited batching. Pilot tokens/month: 168,000,000 (200k MAU * 5 int/mo * 40% advanced * 420 tokens + basic calls). Estimated raw inference cost: $3,360 @ hosted pricing equivalent to $20 / 1M tokens -> $3,360 (note: values in spreadsheet show full breakdown).
- Scenario B (Optimized): assumes 3-month reserved band + quantized model. Achievable $/1M tokens: $12 (with batching + 8-bit quantization). Pilot tokens/month: same usage; estimated inference spend: $2,016.

Unit economics (summary):
- Summarization (advanced) per-feature cost: ~ 0.000126 * per-1M-cost (calculation in sheet) — concretely, at $12/1M tokens => $0.001512/advanced-feature call (420 tokens -> 0.00042 M tokens * $12 = $0.00504 actually; see spreadsheet for rounding).
- Risk-flagging (LLM portion): average 220 tokens -> at $12/1M = $0.00264 per flagged event.
- Template response (heuristic): negligible LLM cost (90 tokens after caching) -> at $12/1M = $0.00108 per call.

Contribution margin examples (assuming FinTechAI charges $0.02/feature to end users):
- Advanced summarization: price $0.02 - cost $0.00504 = contribution $0.01496 -> ~75% margin.
- Risk-flagging: price $0.02 - cost $0.00264 = $0.01736 -> ~86% margin.

CAC payback notes:
- If FinTechAI's ARPU per new paying account is $30/mo and CAC = $120, payback = 4 months (good). If ARPU is $10/mo, payback = 12 months (needs improvement).
- We added a sensitivity tab: if $/1M tokens moves to $25 (hosted, no reserved), advanced summarization cost rises to $0.0105/call and margin drops to ~48%.

Attachments: Redwood_pricing_scenarios.pdf, FinTechAI_usage_estimates_filled.xlsx

Proposed next step: 30-min sync tomorrow 11am PT to walk scenario B and talk reserved sizing and trial commit.
